Video.summary: How can you jump a Ford Raptor even further? Put a supercharger in it. Matt and Bruno team up with Roush Performance to get the maximum power output of a stock Raptor.
Video.title: SuperCharged Raptor

Video.summary: Bruno and Matt find a vintage CJ Jeep and see if they can transform it back to its former glory.
Video.title: Vintage CJ

Video.summary: Bruno goes racing in Charlotte, North Carolina. First, he finds out how a NASCAR team is run at Michael Waltrip Racing; then he checks out a NHRA test session at zMAX Dragway.
Video.title: Bruno Goes Racing

Video.summary: Every Project starts with a Cab and Chassis. On Truck U will show you what to look for when finding the right cab and get a small block engine wired and fired.
Video.title: Wired and Fired

Video.summary: Matt and Bruno completely overhaul the bed of a 1966 Chevy truck.
Video.title: Daily Driver

Video.summary: The world’s largest food truck rally comes to Truck U. Matt and Bruno find a Food Truck that is need of some repair and in the process give the truck a whole new look.
Video.title: Food Truck

Video.summary: A local seafood distributor is ready to grow his business and Truck U is ready to help. Matt and Bruno find a truck, find a work bed and fill it up with seafood.
Video.title: Fisherman’s Fleet

Video.summary: Can Am Commanders are perfect for work and play. On Truck U we do a little of both.
Video.title: UTV Fun

Video.summary: When 4 Wheel Parts ask Truck U to build a signature series Jeep, we said yes. We’ll add a long arm suspension kit with 37 inch tires and take the new JK off-road.
Video.title: Signature Series Jeep

Video.summary: Desert Race Teams need support when they’re in the middle of nowhere. We’ll help one of those teams, by turning a stock Raptor SVT into the Ultimate Chase Truck.
Video.title: Ultimate Chase Truck

Video.summary: When it takes almost 900 horsepower to pull a pro sled truck down a track, things are going to break. Truck U steps in, to take out broken axles and upgrade them for good.
Video.title: Diesel Puller

Video.summary: Matt and Bruno bring in a 1982 GMC that has a lot of show and even more go. They’ll do some custom modifications to the Cummins engine and dress up the exterior.
Video.title: Show and Go

Video.summary: It’s crunch time at Graveyard Carz, Mark and his cousin Dougie fire up the engine for our Turbine Bronze Charger while Dave assembles its firewall in preparation to install the drivetrain.
Video.title: Frankenstein's Work

Video.summary: Dave is ready to wrap up the 1970 Challenger R/T SE but is waiting for parts. Meanwhile, Mark’s A100 build continues, and after a long and tedious body-work and paint phase, Will is ready to deliver Dave the 1969 B5 Blue Plymouth GTX.
Video.title: Look to the West for B5 Blue

Look to the West for B5 Blue

Video.summary: The Ghoulz have finished the 1970 Challenger R/T SE. As they take it out for the first test drive in over 15 years, Mark and the team reflect on the trials and challenges throughout the restoration process.
Video.title: A Challenger Reflected

Video.summary: Mark, Dougie, and Allysa team up to kick things into high-gear around the shop. They begin the restoration of a Challenger T/A, Will paints a 1968 GTX in B7 Blue, Allysa learns how dashes are assembled, and they install the drivetrain for the ultra rare, 1 of 2, 1970 Hemi Convertible Coronet R/T.
Video.title: Mark, Dougie, Allysa, Oh My!

Video.summary: Mark pulls back the curtain on the next four Mopar’s in desperate need of resurrection while also showcasing the fans favorite moments from Seasons 8 and 9.
Video.title: Shaking the Magic 8-Ball

Video.summary: Mark and the Ghouls are back, and they are ready to get to work! With a call in from the owner of the super rare 1 of 2 ever made, 1970 Coronet Hemi Convertible, Mark has to work fast to reach a looming deadline. At the same time, Will primes the body of our 1969 Daytona, bringing it one step closer to being back on the road.
Video.title: Rapping Up the Dash

Video.summary: While Mark is on a road test of the just completed 1968 Charger, its owner surprises the shop by arriving in person! While the owner waits, Will completes the paint on a beautiful 1970 Challenger in B5 blue. Finally, with Mark returned the owner receives his restored Charger and cooks a meal for the Ghouls as thanks!
Video.title: Everybody Loves Raymond

Video.summary: It’s time to hit the casino! Mark has been invited to a massive car show at the Little Creek Casino but before he can go there are a few things that need to be finished first. Mark and Doug disassemble the Phoenix ‘Cuda, a car that survived a massive garage fire. At the car show, Allysa and Will interact with fans and find their “pick of the show.”
Video.title: Upshift Creek

Video.summary: Mark has once again taken Allysa under his wing and is teaching her the finer points of installing a grill and headlights on our 1972 Duster, meanwhile George is in the body shop attaching a tricky quarter panel to a 1969 ‘Cuda which Mark has to check off the list…military style? Finally, the Duster gets it’s drive train and is finally reunited with its engine.
Video.title: It's A Duster Buster

Video.summary: Who better to explain the history and discuss the changes, year to year, of the Dodge Charger, than the Master of Mopar himself, Mark Worman. In this special episode of Graveyard Carz, Mark will show you unique differences, surprising insights, and cool features on multiple years of the same car: the Dodge Charger.
Video.title: Carbituary: Charger

Video.summary: Willie shows off the new engine in his ‘67 Barracuda and gets Kevin to help upgrade his wiring and brakes.
Video.title: You Like My Cuda?

Video.summary: When a 1949 Chevy pick-up shows up at the shop, Kevin and Willie take a look at how far technology has come.
Video.title: Then and Now

Video.summary: The guys tackle an issue with runout on a good set of rotors with the use of an on-car lathe.
Video.title: Rotor Runout

Video.summary: The guys do a complete deconstruction of the new Scorpion diesel engine, showing how the new technology and block design completely revolutionized the 6.7L engine.
Video.title: Diesel Engine Tech

Video.summary: Kevin and Willie take the engine out of a C5 Corvette, tear it down, and get it ready for a performance rebuild.
Video.title: Project C5: Part 1

Video.summary: The guys swap out a damaged clutch on a 2012 Mustang and go for performance with a lightweight twin plate clutch.
Video.title: Mustang Clutch

Video.summary: Our C5 project continues with a build up of the lower end of the LS1 engine.
Video.title: LS1 Engine Build

Video.summary: The suspension gets completely reworked on the C5 Corvette. Then the guys finish up the engine, getting it ready for re-install.
Video.title: Project C5: Part 3

Video.summary: Jeeps are notoriously underpowered, but it’s nothing a supercharger can’t fix.
Video.title: Supercharged Jeep

Video.summary: The guys do their best to help a friend out with some body damage on a 1950 5-window pickup truck. Will it become too much to handle?
Video.title: Body Panel Replacement

Video.summary: A 2000 Silverado comes into the shop with a recurring cooling problem. The guys put their detective hats on and find the root of the problem.
Video.title: Cooling Maintenance

Video.summary: The guys learn what it takes to finish King of the Hammers with the ESAB sponsored Ultra Four race truck in the shop.

Video.summary: Willie B. and Kevin do some detective work on a ‘55 Nomad that may be the next addition to Willie’s collection. Meanwhile, a Jeep Wrangler is in the shop for an illuminating upgrade.
